text:
Priya (sales): Quick help — Singapore POC tomorrow. Client pinned "redwood-pro-v2" but calls from ap-sg return MODEL_NOT_FOUND then rate limits. Need fast triage, a short dedicated trial quote, and security Q&A answers. Logs below.

Marco (se): Can you paste the exact request and any error ids? Did they use model alias or literal name?

Priya (sales): They posted: "model: "redwood-pro-v2"". Proxy log excerpt:
[2026-09-12T14:01:02Z] id=aa331 model=redwood-pro-v2 region=ap-sg status=404 err=MODEL_NOT_FOUND
[2026-09-12T14:01:03Z] id=aa332 model=redwood-pro-v2 region=ap-sg status=429 err=NO_FALLBACK

Olive (infra): Likely the variant isn't staged in ap-sg. Short fixes: enable alias fallback to quantized/compat variants that are deployed, or provision a small Dedicated pool. Need manifest id to stage exact artifact.

Tina (security): Compliance asks: KMS integration, SOC2, and whether logs can be kept in-region. Hosted = SOC2 + encryption, but strict residency needs Dedicated/Private.

Infra-bot: deploy map:
- redwood-pro-v2: manifest M-a9d1 deployed: us-east, eu-central
- redwood-pro-v2-quant: manifest M-a9d1-q deployed: ap-sg (replicas:3)
- redwood-pro-v2-compat: deployed: ap-sg (replicas:1)

Marco (se): Recommended immediate path: enable account-level alias fallback mapping pinned redwood-pro-v2 -> redwood-pro-v2-quant in ap-sg and ask customer to add header x-allow-fallback=1 for the test. Note: quality and latency may differ.

Priya (sales): Customer contact: s.lee@examplecorp.com. They want a 14-day dedicated trial quote for 2x A100 equiv and activation time.

Olive (infra): Ballpark infra cost ~$9k-$11k for 2x A100 for 14d. Recommend quoting $17k including support and monitoring. Activation for Dedicated (provisioning) ~24-48h; alias fallback can be enabled in ~60-90m.

Tina (security): I'll draft short answers for the questionnaire and note differences between hosted vs Dedicated.

Marco (se): Action list:
- Priya: confirm customer ok with fallback variant (need written consent)
- Olive: standby to apply alias fallback if approved
- Billing: prepare short trial quote
- Tina: send security pack

Priya (sales): Asked customer; they accept trying the quantized variant for POC if we note differences. Please enable fallback.

Olive (infra): Enabling alias fallback now.

Infra-bot: Alias rule applied for acct-512: pinned=redwood-pro-v2 -> redwood-pro-v2-quant in ap-sg.

Olive (infra): Quick smoke tests show success, no more 404s. Monitoring for rate spikes.

Priya (sales): Thanks team, I'll send the security pack and quote to S. Lee and close the loop.
